text:
people_ops_anna: Quick follow-up from today's pricing Q&A  leadership will answer short clarifying Qs about rate limits, credits, and packaging here.

eng_zoe: Are rate limits enforced by API key, project, or IP? We saw strange 429s from CI runners.

cto_jen: Primary enforcement is project-level (the project the key belongs to). We also apply per-key and per-IP safeguards for abuse detection, but normal policy = project quota. CI runners sharing a key share the quota.

eng_zoe: If we hit a hard spend cap what status do clients see? Want CI to fail cleanly.

cto_jen: Hard spend caps return 402 (Payment Required). Rate windows return 429. SDKs surface these so you can branch behavior in CI.

cfo_maria: A couple credit points: trial credits expire 90 days from grant. Promo credits show expiration at issuance; enterprise promo terms are negotiated. Refunds of unused promo/trial credits are rare and handled case-by-case for enterprise.

product_maya: Packaging note: we're simplifying small tiers; existing customers are grandfathered for at least 6 months and will get in-console notices 30/14/7 days before changes.

support_bot: [billing-bot] Reminder: expiring credits show a banner in Console -> Billing -> Credits.

people_ops_anna: Thanks! If you have CI-specific logs paste them here and we'll triage with infra. Will post the mini-FAQ link once Product publishes it. :thumbsup:
